description: Versioned adapter from timing records to the engram extraction vocabulary. Validated separately from the profile.

adapters.note: Pull-request merge evidence (PullRequestTimingV1) and final-head CI checks (CiCheckBatchV1); agent runs carry the L2 receipt fields.
One metric of one fingerprinted cohort with its descriptive quantile set and provenance.
Estimate bound to a series with applicability, freshness, support and limitations.
Owner decision bound in seconds with rationale, decision reference and revisit trigger. Carries no sample count and no confidence claim.
Consumer artifact (conductor/planning) built from TimingSeries and TimingEstimate records; immutable once issued.
